markers.reading: Depart the land of the orcs at sunrise on December 10.

evidence.quote: DM: Okay. So, you leave the land of the orcs early in the morning as the sun is rising on December 10th, and head north.

time.basis: Spoken month/day and sunrise; no year spoken

markers.reading: The first several days of northward flight cross the Plaguelands and reach the Mostreve Hills in the middle of the night named December 13, a little more than three days after departure.

evidence.quote: DM: The first several days you pass over the deserted wastelands of the Plaguelands, dusty dry rivers.

DM: ...you pass through the Plaguelands, and by December 13th, in the middle of the night, maybe a little bit more than three days after you left the orcs, you cross the Mostreve Hills, that line of hills, just...
DM: Um, into, um, um, Tyrwingha.

duration.text: a little more than three days
duration.basis: Initial several-day montage is later dated and described as a little more than three days

time.basis: DM names December 13; the nocturnal civil boundary is not specified

markers.note: The named night may straddle December 13–14; do not turn the phrase into an exact civil clock.

markers.reading: Wellby looks into the damaged hull for a minute while the flyers assess the residue.

evidence.quote: DM: Uh, you like look for a minute as Delwath...
DM: Uh, so as you're looking up you can see that there's like this like black like tar like substance that's sort of clinging to the walls.

markers.reading: Sunrise on December 14 finds the ship still over land, with the Western Gulf visible in the distance.

evidence.quote: DM: And as the sun rises, you are in the middle of the Western Gulf. The sun rises on December 14th. Um...
DM: Uh, sorry, as the sun rises on Dec- on December 14th, you can see the Western Gulf in the, in the distance, the shimmering sea that Wellby spent most of his childhood sailing around.
Seeker: Well, we're not quite over the gulf yet, or maybe we are.
Unknown: Yeah. You’re, you’re still on land right now. [laughs]

time.basis: Spoken December 14 sunrise; immediate correction concerns location

markers.reading: Most of the day is spent crossing Tyrwingha, reaching the shores at sunset during Kenzo’s pilot transition.

evidence.quote: DM: So as the sun rises, you cross through, you spend most of the day crossing through the expanse of Tollen and as, um, the night-
DM: Sorry, the expanse of Tyrwingha.

DM: And as, um, you know, as the sun sets and, um, you're reaching the shores, Kenzo, you know, as Kenzo is transitioning, Kenzo, you meditate for a moment as you're connecting to the airship and then to the ocean shores near you, the sea.

end.basis: Same narrated day; sunset arrival is stated

duration.basis: DM narrates the day crossing Tyrwingha, corrected from Tollen

markers.reading: Kenzo flies through the night; the gulf crossing continues through most of the following day and into the next night, reaching the morning of December 16, roughly six days after leaving the orcs.

evidence.quote: DM: And you take over for Seeker and fly through the night.
DM: So it takes you most of the day and into the next night to cross the gulf.
DM: And by the morning of December 16th-
DM: ... roughly six days after you left.
DM: Um, so as the morning of December 16th dawns...

end.basis: Spoken December 16 morning, repeated as dawn

duration.text: through the night, most of the following day and into the next night
duration.basis: Elapsed crossing narration, not the initial miles-per-day forecast

markers.note: Roughly six days is the total from the December 10 departure, not an additional six-day crossing.

markers.reading: Arrival at the busy docks is described as mid-afternoon during the December 16 Tollen arrival.

evidence.quote: DM: To the busy docks of Tollen.
DM: There's, um, everything is sort of cold and a little bit dark because it's, you know, it's mid-afternoon in near the, near the darkest day of the year.

time.basis: Mid-afternoon stated; date carried from the December 16 arrival without an intervening advance

markers.reading: Wellby and Seeker reach Guy’s shop at about two in the afternoon, after the DM first says three.

evidence.quote: DM: So you walk along the street and, and you see his shop and it's, it's probably like 3:00 in the afternoon at this point, 2:00 in the afternoon. Um...
DM: And you enter and he's, his shop is like chaotic.

time.basis: DM revises approximately 3 p.m. to 2 p.m.; date follows the same arrival day

markers.reading: Delwath is back at the ship as the sun starts setting at about four in the afternoon.

evidence.quote: DM: So as, as the sun begins to set in the sky at like 4:00 in the afternoon, um, Delwath is back at the ship.

time.basis: Explicit 4 p.m. sunset on the same Tollen day

markers.reading: Delwath watches Kenzo experimenting in the river for a minute.

evidence.quote: Delwath: I'll watch for a minute, the manta ray, see if it does anything interesting.
Kenzo: Oh yeah, it's going crazy. It's just like, it's like clearly experimenting, leaping out of the water and like-
DM: I mean, when he leap out, when he leaps out of the water you can see that it's Kenzo.
Delwath: On the ship looking down at you.

duration.basis: Declared minute of watching is played out in the following description

markers.reading: The group has been sitting and talking for a while before the busy rush eases and Wendel joins them.

evidence.quote: DM: It's, yeah, so you, I mean, you've been sitting and talking for a while, like, the, the, like, busy rush has died down a little bit, and so you wave him over and he comes.

duration.basis: DM explicitly advances the ongoing conversation until the busy rush dies down

markers.reading: The band winds down at about nine to nine-thirty that evening as the group waits to meet Nika.

evidence.quote: DM: So as you're chatting and hanging out, um, as, you know, as the band begins to wind down, um, towards, towards 9:00, as it's starting to get a bit later, 9:30, um, I assume you've told Wendel that you'd be interested in talking to Nika, and,

time.basis: DM moves from toward 9 p.m. to 9:30; same evening following the December 16 arrival

markers.reading: A few minutes pass after Wellby’s story; Wendel speaks to Nika for a few minutes before she comes to the table.

evidence.quote: Wellby: I, I feel like Wellby would definitely hop up and tell the story of Nayan Sura trapped by Agata.

DM: Um, and after, like, Wellby sits down and, like, you know, a few minutes has, has gone, you see Wendel go over to her and just, you know, kind of talk, uh, to her for a few minutes and, and a few minutes later she gets up and she kind of walks, walks over to your table and sort of-
DM: So Wendel says, “You are interested in the university? Maybe you need a guide?”

duration.text: a few minutes before and during the introduction
duration.basis: Successive short waits narrated without an exact total

markers.reading: The earlier telepathic connection has expired: the DM confirms that much more than an hour has passed.

evidence.quote: DM: I don't think you have telepathy after this time.
DM: It's been way more than an hour.
DM: I don't think Seekers like spending 10 minutes doing a ritual.

duration.basis: DM explicitly confirms more than an hour since the earlier connection; no exact ritual start is supplied

markers.note: This confirms elapsed time already covered by the day and evening; it is not an additional hour after Nika arrives.

markers.reading: Play advances from the evening at the inn to the following morning, when the group decides to visit Melindir.

evidence.quote: DM: So in the morning-
DM: ... uh, do you wanna talk to the, go try and find the priest before you meet Nika, or do you wanna just-
DM: Let's go and talk to the elf.
Seeker: Now we're all going to talk to the elf.

time.basis: Following morning after the independently dated December 16 evening; year remains unstated

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: December 10, 13, 14 and 16 are spoken. The following morning is December 17 by continuation. The year 1748 comes only from YAML.
yamlCheck.explanation: The spoken December 10 departure through December 16 arrival accounts for six calendar transitions; the explicit next-morning advance before Melindir adds one. The internal midnight label remains approximate without changing the overall span. Real-world bedtime and tomorrow scheduling after u4822 add no adventure day.
